messages:
Sarah (AE): Hi all — ArborBank wants to kick off a 6-week POC starting next Mon. Scope: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning for ~25k identities (incremental sync), group->role mapping, RBAC sync, multi-subdomain domain verification, and a security questionnaire. Need POC runbook + temporary pricing by EOW.
Miguel (SE): Quick q's: 1) Are they doing a one-time backfill + incremental or incremental-only? 2) Do they expect nested groups? 3) Any required uptime during the POC?
Alex (ArborBank): We'll do an initial backfill (one-off) then incremental deltas. We use nested groups in Okta. POC SLA: reasonable uptime during business hours, nothing contractual.
Miguel (SE): We support nested group flattening and group->role transforms. Example mapping to include in runbook:
```
okta.groupName -> product.role
arbor_ops -> operator
arbor_read -> viewer
arbor_admins -> admin
```
Backfill notes: on Dedicated we can pump ~25k users in batches; estimate 30-60m depending on batch size and rate-lift. Hosted may hit rate limits without prior approval.
Tom (Sales Eng Manager): Recommend Dedicated for the POC to avoid throttling during the backfill. For temporary pricing, propose a 6-week uplift: 2x dedicated GPUs + provisioning throughput — ballpark $6k-$9k. I'll get precise numbers from finance.
Priya (Security): Need SOC2 report, encryption at rest details, KMS/HSM option for Private, audit log retention (they asked for 90d), data residency for EU, and confirmation we don't store PHI in SCIM attrs. Please attach the security questionnaire link.
Erin (Legal): We'll need to confirm DPA and data processing addendum for EU. If SCIM contains PHI, we'll need a HIPAA amendment. Also confirm support for contractual SSO metadata upload and SAML cert rotation process.
Sarah (AE): Action list: Miguel -> POC runbook with SCIM delta examples, nested group handling, sample logs, and domain verification steps. Priya & Erin -> answer SQ + confirm DPA/HIPAA path. Tom -> draft provisional POC pricing + short-term commit. Target: Friday EOD.
Miguel (SE): Domain verification: we support DNS TXT and email verification per subdomain; for multi-subdomain recommend DNS automation. Example TXT: `redwood-verification=arborbank-poc-1973`. For SAML we accept metadata XML or manual IdP config; both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows supported.
Alex (ArborBank): Can you also hold SCIM event logs for 90d for audit? That's a must.
Priya (Security): Default log retention is 30d on Hosted. We can extend to 90d on Dedicated or Private (add-on). I'll list impact on storage and cost in SQ response.
Miguel (SE): I'll include sample SCIM request/response snippets and an example error-handling pattern for deprovisioning edge cases. Also will add a runbook section: "How to request a temporary SCIM rate lift" with contact and expected lead time.
Sarah (AE): I'll update the opportunity and schedule a kickoff once runbook is ready. Thanks team :thumbsup:
